program='''def transform(grid):
    lines = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    output = []
    for j, start in enumerate(lines):
        color = grid[start][0]
        if color == 9:
            continue
        end = lines[j + 1] if j + 1 < len(lines) else len(grid)
        section = grid[start + 1:end]
        height = sum(any(cell == color for cell in row) for row in section)
        has_gray = any(5 in row for row in section)
        count = height // 2 + int(height % 2 == 1 and has_gray)
        output.append([color] * count + [0] * (3 - count) + [9, 5 if has_gray else 0])
    return output
'''
